reserveReview.rationale: Write-time re-open 2026-07-28: (1) Kreston Digital Assets Ltd ISRS 4400 (Revised) Agreed-Upon Procedures PDF states gold reserves held on 28 Nov 2025 are the backing asset for USDKG, documents hand-over of 30 bars totaling around 376 kg via LLC Virelint Group into bank storage in 15 sealed boxes, and values the gold at $50,331,256 (LBMA $4,163.475/oz) with no non-gold reserve category in scope. (2) usdkg.com/transparency still presents a single Reserves Composition category—Collateralization (Gold) $54.8M against USDKG in Circulation $50M—indexes the same Q4/November 2025 Kreston PDF, and states quarterly audits verify circulating tokens remain fully backed by physical gold reserves. (3) Issuer audit summary (2025-12-08) independently restates Kreston's AUP covering existence, ownership, quantity, valuation, serial/purity documentation, sealed storage, transport records, and custody agreements for the same 30-bar / ~376 kg physical gold stock, and states the stablecoin is backed entirely by physical gold. Composition remains a single 100% physical-gold slice; no second asset class is disclosed. The active reserve-risk rubric classifies physical bullion as very-low risk; structured risk factors retain gold-market, physical-custody, counterparty, legal, redemption-liquidity, and concentration exposures. Formal quantity pin remains the 2025-11-28 AUP; live portal figures still show gold-only collateralization. Lockstep pin 2026-08-08: compositionAsOf anchored to the November 2025 Kreston AUP that latestReport records - the only artefact valuing the gold ($50.3M, 30 bars ~376kg); the composition is a single allocated-gold category and the live transparency page read of 2026-07-28 is retained as corroboration of category continuity, not of quantity.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Kreston Digital Assets ISRS 4400 gold verification as of 28 November 2025 (single physical-gold category), corroborated by the live gold-only page
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No reserve asset class remains unidentified; current bar-level public allocation, named depository bank, custody concentration, and holder redemption timing remain outside the composition percentage.
